_sobre: Programs with known compatibility in the WinApps engine. 'match' uses regular expressions (case-insensitive) against: file = file name, product = ProductName/FileDescription/CompanyName of the .exe, content = the file's bytes. Rules are checked in order and the first match wins, so specific rules come before generic ones. Human-readable fields are in ENGLISH: name, summary, why, alt, fixes, category, app_name, and the labels in mac_menu and titlebar_buttons. The optional object 'pt' holds the same keys in Brazilian Portuguese; when the interface language is Portuguese each key there replaces the English one (missing keys fall back to English). status: 'funciona' (works), 'parcial' (partial) 'nao-funciona' (doesn't work) or 'nao-testado' (wanted, not tested yet: list of the most requested Windows programs to test). 'outlook' (only for nao-testado) = prediction from the program's technology vs. what the engine supports: likely, uncertain or unlikely — identifiers, never translated. 'verified' = tested end to end by WinApps, with the fixes it needs (Verified badge). 'tested' = date of the last test (DD/MM/YYYY). 'fixes' = WinApps fixes the program relies on. 'category' = group in the table. 'kind': 'app' (one program) or 'grupo' (generic rule by technology). 'needs' = components WinApps installs first (winrt-metadata, webview2, dotnet48…). 'app_name' = shortcut name (the program's real product name, normally the same in every language). 'summary' = one-line summary (table); 'why'/'alt' = details when expanded. 'mac_menu' = the program's Mac menus (each item presses one of its keyboard shortcuts); menu '@app' = items in the menu named after the program. 'titlebar_height' = height (points) of the program's own title bar when it is HTML (WebView2) and the engine can't measure it. 'titlebar_buttons' = buttons on the Mac title bar {left, right: [label, action, SF Symbol]}; action = a shortcut ('ctrl+s') or 'click:X,Y' (points from the window's top-left corner; negative X counts from the right) on an item of the hidden title bar; 'click!:X,Y' = a click that opens a window: retried once if none appears. Symbol '@floppy' = floppy disk drawn by WinApps (macOS has none). Menus and title bar buttons are written when the shortcut is created, in the interface language at that moment. COMPATIBILITY.md and COMPATIBILIDADE.md are generated from this file (compat-md.py). User guide: GUIDE.md / GUIA.md.

pt.why: Launcher; muitos jogos D3D12. Previsão: Launcher com Chromium embutido (CEF): a renderização entre processos do motor (feita p/ WebView2) deve ajudar, mas CEF ainda não foi provado.

rules.name: GOG Galaxy (Windows games)
rules.why: DRM-free GOG games are the best candidates for the engine. Outlook: Launcher with an embedded Chromium (CEF) UI: the engine's cross-process rendering (made for WebView2) should help, but CEF isn't proven yet.

pt.why: Jogos da GOG sem DRM são os melhores candidatos para o motor. Previsão: Launcher com Chromium embutido (CEF): a renderização entre processos do motor (feita p/ WebView2) deve ajudar, mas CEF ainda não foi provado.

rules.name: Riot Client (League of Legends)
rules.why: League has a Mac client; Valorant uses Vanguard (kernel anti-cheat).

pt.why: O LoL tem cliente Mac; o Valorant usa Vanguard (anti-cheat de kernel).

rules.name: Valorant
rules.why: Vanguard kernel anti-cheat — impossible outside real Windows.

pt.why: Anti-cheat de kernel Vanguard — impossível fora do Windows real.

rules.name: Fortnite
rules.why: EasyAntiCheat/BattlEye kernel mode; no Mac version since 2020.

pt.why: EasyAntiCheat/BattlEye em modo kernel; sem versão Mac desde 2020.

rules.name: Counter-Strike 2
rules.why: Mac version dropped; VAC is user-mode, but CS2 is Vulkan/D3D11 heavy. Outlook: Direct3D 11 through DXMT (Metal): works for simple apps; heavy 3D viewports/games untested.

pt.why: Versão Mac removida; o VAC é de usuário, mas o CS2 é pesado (Vulkan/D3D11). Previsão: Direct3D 11 via DXMT (Metal): funciona em apps simples; viewport 3D pesado/jogos não testados.

rules.name: GTA V / FiveM / Red Dead Redemption 2
rules.why: GTA Online now uses BattlEye (blocks); story mode/RDR2 possible with D3D12 support. Outlook: Needs Direct3D 12: only partial support (see the D3D12 rule).

pt.why: O GTA Online usa BattlEye (bloqueia); modo história/RDR2 possíveis com D3D12. Previsão: Precisa de Direct3D 12: suporte só parcial (ver regra D3D12).

rules.name: Roblox (Windows)
rules.why: Roblox has a Mac client; the Windows client uses Hyperion anti-tamper that blocks Wine.

pt.why: O Roblox tem cliente Mac; o do Windows usa Hyperion, que bloqueia o Wine.

rules.name: Minecraft Bedrock (Windows)
rules.why: Microsoft Store/GDK package (MSIX); Java Edition has Mac.

pt.why: Pacote da Microsoft Store (MSIX); a Java Edition tem Mac.

rules.name: Call of Duty / Warzone
rules.why: Ricochet kernel anti-cheat.

pt.why: Anti-cheat de kernel Ricochet.

rules.name: Apex Legends / PUBG / Rainbow Six Siege
rules.why: Kernel anti-cheat (EAC/BattlEye).

pt.why: Anti-cheat de kernel (EAC/BattlEye).

rules.name: Genshin Impact / Honkai Star Rail
rules.why: mhyprot kernel anti-cheat (Genshin has iPad/Mac Catalyst via App Store on Apple silicon).

pt.why: Anti-cheat de kernel mhyprot (no Mac Apple silicon há versão da App Store).

rules.name: Elden Ring / Dark Souls
rules.why: EAC is disabled offline; D3D12 needed. Outlook: Needs Direct3D 12: only partial support (see the D3D12 rule).

pt.why: EAC desligado no offline; precisa D3D12. Previsão: Precisa de Direct3D 12: suporte só parcial (ver regra D3D12).

rules.name: The Witcher 3 / Cyberpunk 2077
rules.why: Cyberpunk has a Mac version; Witcher 3 D3D11 build is a candidate. Outlook: Direct3D 11 through DXMT (Metal): works for simple apps; heavy 3D viewports/games untested.

pt.why: Cyberpunk tem Mac; o Witcher 3 (D3D11) é candidato. Previsão: Direct3D 11 via DXMT (Metal): funciona em apps simples; viewport 3D pesado/jogos não testados.

rules.name: Tibia (official client) / other MMOs
rules.why: Tibia has a Linux/Mac-less client; very close to the RubinOT case. Outlook: Direct3D 11 through DXMT (Metal): works for simple apps; heavy 3D viewports/games untested.

pt.why: O cliente do Tibia é parecido com o caso RubinOT. Previsão: Direct3D 11 via DXMT (Metal): funciona em apps simples; viewport 3D pesado/jogos não testados.

rules.name: Ragnarök Online / MU Online / Lineage II private servers
rules.why: Old D3D7–9 MMOs; private servers often add GameGuard/kernel anti-cheat (blocks). Outlook: Plain Win32/Delphi/MFC program: same class as Notepad++, 7-Zip and PuTTY, which work.

pt.why: MMOs antigos D3D7–9; servidores privados costumam ter GameGuard (bloqueia). Previsão: Programa Win32/Delphi/MFC simples: mesma classe de Notepad++, 7-Zip e PuTTY, que funcionam.

rules.name: Age of Empires II DE / IV
rules.why: D3D11; multiplayer anti-cheat is user-mode. Outlook: Direct3D 11 through DXMT (Metal): works for simple apps; heavy 3D viewports/games untested.

pt.why: D3D11; anti-cheat do multiplayer é de usuário. Previsão: Direct3D 11 via DXMT (Metal): funciona em apps simples; viewport 3D pesado/jogos não testados.

rules.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 (Windows build)
rules.why: Has a Mac version. Outlook: Has a native Mac version — use it; the Windows build is only for Windows-only extras.

pt.why: Tem versão Mac. Previsão: Tem versão Mac nativa — use-a; a do Windows só p/ extras exclusivos.

rules.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator
rules.why: Microsoft Store/GDK + D3D12 + 100+ GB streaming; out of reach.

pt.why: Microsoft Store/GDK + D3D12 + 100+ GB; fora de alcance.

rules.name: Game with kernel-level protection
rules.why: This program uses kernel-level protection, which requires a real Windows PC.
rules.alt: Check whether the game has a Mac version or a cloud gaming service.
rules.summary: Kernel-level protection requires a real Windows PC

pt.name: Jogo com proteção de kernel
pt.summary: Proteção de kernel exige um Windows real
pt.why: Este programa usa proteção de kernel, que exige um Windows de verdade.
pt.alt: Veja se o jogo tem versão para Mac ou serviço de jogo na nuvem.

rules.name: Program with a built-in browser (WebView2)
rules.why: Uses WebView2 (Edge's built-in browser). WinApps installs the WebView2 Runtime if it's missing and draws its screens through Metal.
rules.alt: If a screen stays blank, quit and reopen the program; the first image may take a few seconds.
rules.summary: WebView2 included and drawn through Metal

pt.name: Programa com navegador embutido (WebView2)
pt.summary: WebView2 já incluso e desenhado pelo Metal
pt.why: Usa o WebView2 (navegador embutido do Edge). O WinApps instala o WebView2 Runtime se faltar e desenha as telas dele pelo Metal.
pt.alt: Se alguma tela ficar em branco, feche e abra o programa de novo; a 1ª imagem pode levar alguns segundos.

rules.name: Direct3D 12 game
rules.why: Uses Direct3D 12, which the engine doesn't support on the Mac. Some games have a Direct3D 11 option, which works.
rules.alt: Look for a Direct3D 11 mode in the game's options (or -dx11 on the command line).
rules.summary: No Direct3D 12; use the game's Direct3D 11 mode

pt.name: Jogo em Direct3D 12
pt.summary: Sem Direct3D 12; use o modo Direct3D 11 do jogo
pt.why: Usa Direct3D 12, que o motor não suporta no Mac. Alguns jogos têm opção de Direct3D 11, que funciona.
pt.alt: Procure nas opções do jogo um modo Direct3D 11 (ou -dx11 na linha de comando).
